V=/home/samyak/.local/state/distbench/evidence/2026-11-09-build/gradavg_mpi_to_nccl/verify; cat > $V/measure.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# measure.sh: run inside distbench-agent:u08-gpu12 with the worktree at /wt (read-only) and this folder
# at /v. Builds given, reference/single, reference/expert, variants/valid and probe/ (given/ plus env
# knobs) and runs them at visible and hidden on this GPU (2 ranks share it, each its own NCCL_HOSTID;
# single on 1 rank). Every run's params.bin goes to /v/out-<size>/<name>/. Log: /v/measure.log.
set -uo pipefail
export PATH=/usr/local/cuda/bin:$PATH
pkg=/wt/tasks/gradavg_mpi_to_nccl
sizes=${SIZES:-visible hidden}
log=/v/measure.log
for d in given reference/single reference/expert variants/valid; do
  b=/v/build/${d//\//-}; rm -rf "$b"; mkdir -p "$b"; cp -R "$pkg/$d"/. "$b"/
  (cd "$b" && make -s) >> "$log" 2>&1 || { echo "BUILD FAIL $d" | tee -a "$log"; exit 1; }
done
b=/v/build/probe; rm -rf "$b"; mkdir -p "$b"; cp -R /v/probe/. "$b"/
(cd "$b" && make -s) >> "$log" 2>&1 || { echo "BUILD FAIL probe" | tee -a "$log"; exit 1; }
echo "builds ok (no NCCL_HOME set)" | tee -a "$log"
cmdline() {  # size out
  python3 - "$pkg/package.json" "$1" "$2" <<'PY'
import json, re, sys
spec = json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); values = {"size": sys.argv[2], "out": sys.argv[3], "nodes": "1", "ranks_per_node": "2"}
values.update({k: str(v) for k, v in spec["sizes"][sys.argv[2]].items()})
print(re.sub(r"(?<!\$)\{([a-z][a-z0-9_]*)\}", lambda m: values[m.group(1)], spec["run"]))
PY
}
two() {  # name build size [env...]
  local name=$1 build=$2 size=$3; shift 3
  local out=/v/out-$size/$name; mkdir -p "$out"; local cmd; cmd=$(cmdline "$size" "$out")
  local t0; t0=$(date +%s.%N)
  (cd /v/build/$build && env "$@" mpirun -np 2 --oversubscribe -x GA_FRAC -x GA_COMPUTE -x GA_DUMP \
     bash -c "NCCL_HOSTID=m-rank-\$OMPI_COMM_WORLD_RANK exec $cmd") > "$out/stdout" 2> "$out/stderr"
  local rc=$?
  echo "$size $name rc=$rc wall=$(python3 -c "print(round($(date +%s.%N)-$t0,1))") $(tail -n1 "$out/stdout")" | tee -a "$log"
}
for size in $sizes; do
  two given given "$size"
  out=/v/out-$size/single; mkdir -p "$out"
  t0=$(date +%s.%N)
  (cd /v/build/reference-single && $(cmdline "$size" "$out")) > "$out/stdout" 2> "$out/stderr"
  echo "$size single rc=$? wall=$(python3 -c "print(round($(date +%s.%N)-$t0,1))") $(tail -n1 "$out/stdout")" | tee -a "$log"
  two expert reference-expert "$size"
  two valid variants-valid "$size"
  two probe-fp32 probe "$size" GA_DUMP=190,195,196,197,198,199
  for f in 0.99 0.98 0.95 0.90 0.85; do two "probe-frac$f" probe "$size" GA_FRAC=$f; done
  two probe-tf32 probe "$size" GA_COMPUTE=tf32
  two probe-bf16 probe "$size" GA_COMPUTE=bf16
done
echo "measure done" | tee -a "$log"
EOF
chmod +x $V/measure.sh; echo ok
